3.result: Four items wrap into three columns without dropping content. Capacity failures return proposals without a transaction. Reflow emits geometry plus binding metadata; theme is a separate transaction and neither rewrites content.

baselineMethod: Isolated git archive of the starting commit, separately built and tested; no implementation changes in that checkout.
limitations: Only executable declared column controls are exposed; no arbitrary CSS, scripts or JSON paths.
Global theme changes that affect protected styles or field locks are rejected.
Capacity failure proposes another recipe or explicit slide splitting; it never auto-inserts a slide.
Invalid bindings require explicit rebuildBinding through the shared agent planner.
